title: Beyond the Leaderboard: Rethinking Medical Benchmarks for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the natural language distribution across 53 medical LLM benchmarks to identify language centralization and the underrepresentation of non-English languages.

Categorizing the diseases covered in the evaluated benchmarks according to the ICD-11 classification system to identify overrepresented areas (e.g., musculoskeletal, skin) and underrepresented conditions (e.g., mental and behavioral disorders).

Analyzing the distribution of benchmarks across clinical departments to identify the overrepresentation of specific specialties (e.g., Surgery, General Practice) and the neglect of others (e.g., Rehabilitation, Occupational Health).
Meta-evaluating whether the 53 medical LLM benchmarks include explicit evaluation metrics, methodologies, and test cases for fairness across demographic groups (e.g., gender, ethnicity, age).
